order: first planned card with verified completed dependencies

cards.title: Freeze the artifact and authority catalog
work: Remeasure HEAD/version and preserve unrelated changes; inventory actual schemas, template validity, consumers and status authority.
Freeze per-kind public semantic fields, Core fields, initialization defaults, reference phases and explicit two-step child/index update semantics.
Resolve compatibility policy for format assertions, metadata canonicalization and nested extension fields; document version impact before code.
cards.red: A schema-valid status patch, illustrative nonexistent requirement_delta kind, or universal injected schema_version must be rejected by the ownership design.
cards.green: Catalog covers all ten existing storage schemas and every initial public operation; no unresolved policy permits bypass or silent content loss.
cards.test: Read-only schema/template/source cross-check; record current hashes and negative contract examples.

cards.title: Define typed operation and receipt contracts
work: Specify create/update/validate/describe envelopes, strict JSON diagnostics, request IDs, JSON Pointer patch semantics and receipt scopes.
Create per-kind operation descriptors referencing authoritative storage fields instead of copying a universal schema.
Define bundle location/resolution for descriptors and backward compatibility of operation v1 separately from schema v3.
cards.red: Unknown fields, missing semantic inputs, protected-field request and conflicting operation paths fail protocol tests.
cards.green: Closed nested input/receipt shapes, version/hash identities and exact error/exit semantics pass; no runtime writes yet.

cards.title: Implement strict bounded input and artifact readers
work: Reject duplicate JSON/YAML keys, custom tags, aliases/merges outside policy, nonfinite values, excessive depth/bytes and malformed encodings.
Split frontmatter at byte-defined delimiters without stripping body; return raw metadata/body segments and typed mapping.
Characterize legacy valid scalar/date behavior; separate parse failure from schema failure and preserve existing read-only consumers until migration.
cards.red: Duplicate ID currently last-wins; trailing body blank lines vanish; strict reader tests expose both and cyclic/large malformed input.
cards.green: Deterministic field-specific parse errors; body segment preserved byte-for-byte including CRLF/non-ASCII/BOM policy.

cards.title: Resolve pinned schemas and structured validation
work: Resolve operation/storage schema bytes through verified installed bundle and exact product lock; reject mismatch rather than fallback to CWD.
Add structured diagnostics while preserving existing human-readable SchemaRegistry API consumers.
Apply explicit format/type rules and per-kind reference adapters; label whole-gate checks not evaluated.
cards.red: Wrong schema hash, corrupt bundle, date annotation wrongly assumed enforced, missing current reference or inherited-version mismatch must fail.
cards.green: Valid legacy extension fields remain supported; projected operation schemas reject unexposed new keys without silently closing storage schema.

cards.title: Implement deterministic YAML/frontmatter codec
work: Define stable key/scalar/multiline policies, Unicode, ordered lists and null/date distinctions.
Pre-serialize round-trip equality validates emitted bytes against exact typed candidate.
Preserve body bytes; detect noncanonical old metadata and require explicit format-change opt-in with preview hash.
cards.red: Quoted yes/date/leading-zero string changes type, list order changes, comments disappear without opt-in or body suffix changes.
cards.green: Equivalent key-order inputs yield equal canonical bytes under same context; every adversarial scalar/body fixture survives or fails before write.

cards.title: Implement typed patches and immutable-field protection
work: Implement set/remove pointers, explicit null and whole-array replacement; reject overlap/index edits and required removals.
Preserve every untouched schema-valid field, including allowed extension trees and exact body unless explicit replacement.
Enforce per-kind semantic field masks recursively and verify complete post-patch candidate.
cards.red: Nested status replacement, ancestor replacement bypass, accidental null deletion or lost unrelated extension values must fail.
cards.green: Positive patches leave unselected values intact; malformed/unauthorized patches produce zero persistence actions.

cards.title: Bind Core authorization, paths and source identity
work: Resolve configured roots, selected Change/task/pass and separate Worker versus authenticated Core operation policies.
Bind envelope/lock/schema/source inputs to authorization fingerprint; revalidation API used under commit lock.
Reject path traversal, links/reparse escapes, case/ADS/device aliases and protected .deltafuse paths; no public core flag.
cards.red: Null envelope, forged actor=core, stale pass context, immutable intake target or symlink escaping a product root must deny without writes.
cards.green: Authorized intended stage writes succeed; real decide/evidence internal caller cannot be confused with a generic Worker permission.

cards.title: Implement single-file atomic publication primitives
work: Stage bytes beside destination, validate/read-back staged content and fsync; implement platform-correct no-replace create and atomic replacement update.
Preserve existing artifact on serialization/permission/sharing failure; avoid truncate-and-rewrite fallback.
Define file permissions, staging cleanup ownership and precise durability limits on Windows/POSIX.
cards.red: Two creates race on one absent path; truncated existing file after crash; cross-filesystem temp or Windows sharing error loses original.
cards.green: Exactly one concurrent create succeeds; old-or-new full bytes visible, not partial content; real platform checks pass.

cards.title: Implement mutation locking and optimistic concurrency
work: Use shared product-level lock for cooperating Core mutations, required whole-file expected hash and current authority/source recheck.
Specify lock liveness/recovery and no-op behavior; no blind age-based stale lock deletion.
Test target changes and changed governing spec/envelope separately; disclose external-editor limitations.
cards.red: Two updates read same hash and both succeed; wrong-body hash accepted; authority revoked between prepare and commit but write proceeds.
cards.green: Only one competing stale update commits; other fails unchanged; same payload no-op preserves bytes; explicit hostile-writer scope documented.

cards.title: Implement durable receipts, idempotency and crash recovery
work: Define prepared/published/committed records binding request/input/schema/before/after/Core identity and durable receipt refs.
Recover by exact hashes, detect ambiguous third-party edit, and reuse request_id only for identical payload.
Handle failure after publication as explicit recoverable/unknown outcome; never replay evidence execution or gate acceptance.
cards.red: Crash at each persistence boundary, reused ID with new payload, lost receipt after replace, or retry rolling back a newer external edit.
cards.green: Recovery yields known committed or unchanged state with no fabricated receipt; ambiguous state stops; post-readback failure never reports success.

cards.title: Assemble the typed Artifact Writer service
work: Wire create/update/validate/describe through one implementation with correct transaction sequencing.
Implement task/slice/spec-delta/routing and permitted Change metadata operations; Core supplies initial states only.
Return exact receipt/diagnostics; validate is strictly read-only and refuses unsupported kinds without guessing.
cards.red: Generic task create advances status; failed validation leaves files/journal changed; receipt says semantic_verified for an untested narrative.
cards.green: Supported artifacts created without raw YAML; failed requests do not alter artifacts; validate changes no receipt/journal; correct scoped results.

cards.title: Expose CLI and small tool-call schemas
work: Add describe/create/update/validate CLI over same service with JSON stdin/file, bounded output and documented exits.
Export per-kind/operation tool argument schema; do not build provider-specific LLM or IDE/MCP server here.
Test dry formatting preview/opt-in, Unicode shell transport and actual subprocess calls without unsafe shell interpolation.
cards.red: CLI bypasses Python service policy, invalid JSON writes file, escaping multiline payload alters content, or public tool offers core-only fields.
cards.green: Python/CLI produce equivalent artifacts/errors and show schema hash/version; no raw YAML authoring required.

cards.title: Integrate Core execution evidence including verification
work: Route existing stamped evidence serialization through internal validated persistence without exposing a public arbitrary stamp call.
Add authorized change-level --phase verification execution with task=null and fixed evidence/verification/run.yaml; retain old three phases/task rules.
Bind actual command/result/source baseline before stamping; handle timeouts/unapproved runner/source drift independently from serialization.
cards.red: Worker supplies passed+stamp, verification requests task evidence semantics, baseline drifts or retries rerun a command merely to repair a receipt.
cards.green: Actual verification command produces gate-consumable Core evidence; forgery/stale snapshot still rejected; old evidence tests remain green.

cards.title: Integrate status and Human Gate persistence safely
work: Share lock/persistence beneath state/advance/decide but retain exact authorization/gate tables and existing receipt semantics.
Design compatibility for old receipts and incomplete transitions; avoid dual uncoordinated journals.
Make all relevant cooperating status writers use same lock, including rollback/recovery entrypoints.
cards.red: Generic patch verified/accepted, nested status smuggling, crash between transition log and target, or duplicated Human Gate action.
cards.green: Legal current commands behave identically; unauthorized requests fail; old receipt replay and explicit recovery are proven with real files.

cards.title: Repair scaffold and integrate derived indexes
work: Reconcile new scaffold with Change schema: resolve pin/source/structural initial collections from explicit creation contract, require semantic fields or clearly label incomplete scaffold.
Route coverage derived serialization through internal service; no Worker-editable derived coverage truth.
Implement explicit Change child-index update from existing child identity and Core-resolved status; second operation is independently atomic and gate checks detect incomplete indexing.
cards.red: Scaffold silently invents title/intent, bogus created field survives, copied parent child-status can override actual child, or coverage self-certifies nonexistent evidence.
cards.green: Supported full scaffold validates; incomplete scaffold not misreported valid; deterministic indexes reflect actual artifacts and remain gated.

cards.title: Synchronize docs, skills, templates and packaged assets
work: Document service vs runtime roles, field ownership, validation scopes, compatibility and read-only validate behavior in EN/RU.
Update relevant skill/examples to typed operations and actual evidence/state commands; never make structured output provider support mandatory.
Bundle operation descriptors with hashes, preserve DO NOT EDIT version/source/hash snapshots and validate against pins; generated assets via tooling only.
cards.red: Wheel without descriptors, stale adapters, docs instruct raw passed evidence, or skill auto-accepts Gate.
cards.green: Source/bundle/installed skill contracts match; field/schema examples validate; installer retains manually maintained product artifacts.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_artifact_assets.py tests/unit/test_templates.py -q; python scripts/sync_assets.py --check

cards.title: Prove backwards compatibility and full workflow integration
work: Capture valid manual artifacts including open extension fields, comments, CRLF bodies, old receipts and all route types.
Run a complete feature and unchanged-spec bugfix lifecycle using writer plus genuine Core commands, including Human Gate pause semantics.
Assert raw/manual authoring remains valid, no automatic migration and format opt-in exact-hash binding.
cards.red: Valid manual extension dropped, normalization bypasses decision gate, docs/ops forced into product pytest or bugfix needs invented spec delta.
cards.green: Both manual and typed flows retain semantic/gate behavior; body preservation and explicit formatting compatibility pass.

cards.title: Run security, crash and platform acceptance matrix
work: Run malformed/unknown/status/path/receipt attacks, concurrent creates/updates and hard-crash recovery on Windows and actual POSIX.
Run full pytest, both smoke/layout validators on fresh product installs, asset drift, legacy runtime search and wheel-without-checkout check.
Classify mandatory skips/platform limitations as open acceptance, preserve immutable external evidence and source hashes.
cards.red: Any hidden fallback to direct write, missing mandatory live platform test or successful unauthorized state/evidence mutation blocks acceptance.
cards.green: All deterministic safety/regression checks pass with commands/exit/log hashes; limitations explicit, no synthetic substitute for platform behavior.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider; platform smoke/layout and installed-wheel checks in VALIDATION.md

cards.title: Build paired small-model evaluation protocol and corpus
work: Freeze matched raw-YAML/manual versus typed-writer cases, same model/profile/budgets/semantic oracle, randomized order and fresh sessions.
Include meaningful prose/metadata, partial updates, missing semantic values, legacy comments and denied authority; retain every attempt/dropout.
Separate JSON/YAML/field/policy/evidence failures; optional constrained-output arm isolated from writer effect; harness invokes external configured agent, no fake score.
cards.red: Parser-only score ignores semantic regressions, hides formatting refusals/JSON failures, excludes failed sessions or alters oracle by arm.
cards.green: Protocol/power-or-exploratory label, sample/seed schedule, metrics and acceptance criteria frozen before live runs; fixture tests prove unbiased accounting.

cards.title: Run paired external small-model evaluation
work: Use authorized available smaller-model endpoint with fixed actual identity and no hidden substitution; attest both arm profiles.
Run preregistered pairs; preserve raw prompts/tool attempts/outcomes/receipts and independently evaluate semantics/gates.
Report paired mechanical retry differences, first-pass rates, end-to-end semantic success, tokens/time diagnostics and uncertainty; no fabricated missing runs.
cards.red: Only tool syntax improves while semantic mistakes rise, results omit unsupported cases, or measured model identity absent.
cards.green: Real data demonstrates or falsifies benefit honestly; mechanical improvement alone cannot satisfy acceptance without unchanged independent semantic safeguards.
cards.test: Execute frozen evaluation protocol with documented endpoint; record exact argv/exit and external run evidence.

cards.title: Close acceptance and publish migration/handoff
work: Reopened after review: reconcile all AW-21 through AW-28 evidence and original acceptance before replacing the historical completion report. Missing/inconclusive required evidence keeps closure open.
Reconcile every source acceptance criterion with actual evidence; keep any inconclusive performance result or unsupported platform open.
Publish practical examples, old/new capability detection, manual-authoring fallback, canonicalization opt-in and recovery procedure.
Record tested implementation/contract/wheel identities and next backlog step without pushing or default-branch merge.
cards.red: Unit success substitutes for real small-model result, old client silently rewrites unknown schemas, or migration instructions auto-change manual artifacts.
cards.green: All required evidence mapped, supported scope accurate and independently reviewable; done only when source acceptance is actually satisfied.
cards.test: Final evidence hash/link/schema audit; git diff --check; scoped source status; no unrequested commit/push.

cards.title: Enforce live Core authorization and target containment
work: Resolve the actual product root, owning Change and current Core-selected work envelope; reject missing/halted, wrong-stage, wrong-task and wrong-owner authority before any mutation.
Route every public target through configured-root containment and kind/identity checks, including symlink/reparse, case, ADS and protected-path handling; do not trust caller absolute paths.
Recompute live authorization/source/lock identity under the commit lock. Preserve legitimate internal Core commands without exposing an actor privilege in the public API.
Exercise the public service and CLI, not only standalone policy helpers; describe/validate must remain side-effect free and report only checks actually performed.
cards.red: Reproduce an outside-Change write, missing-context write and stale-envelope write through public entry points; assert all must fail without changing targets, journals or receipts.
cards.green: Public mutation requires live Core authority and kind-correct contained targets; revoked authority fails before publication; read-only operations create no internal directories.
cards.test: Run policy/service/CLI/security tests and Core authorization regressions, including real filesystem path cases where supported.

cards.title: Reject missing task semantics and unresolved references
work: Define required semantic inputs per supported operation from the canonical contract and descriptors; remove invented title/kind/refs/budget/Change/slice fallbacks.
Obtain only authorized identity bindings and initial lifecycle status from Core; missing Core context is an error.

Wire operation and reference validation into create/update before publication. Validate existing prerequisites and identities; distinguish declared future spec changes from references that must already exist.
Replace tests that reward guessed semantics with explicit complete fixtures; keep a missing-field and missing-reference negative matrix. Synchronize generated assets when descriptors change.
cards.red: Empty payload and independently omitted title/kind/spec refs must reject; dangling or wrong-identity slice/spec/dependency references must not commit.
cards.green: No unsupported semantic default is supplied, all required omissions have field-specific diagnostics, and valid explicit semantic requests preserve existing lifecycle behavior.
cards.test: Run descriptor/schema/service/reference tests and affected workflow fixtures; verify generated assets.

cards.title: Wire strict bounded parsing into public operation envelopes
work: Use the strict reader and closed operation envelope at actual file/stdin entry points; bound bytes before unbounded reads and enforce depth/Unicode/finite-number constraints.
Reject duplicate keys at every depth, unknown fields/operations and invalid nested types before constructing mutation state; apply equivalent typed validation to the Python service.
Preserve documented optional-field semantics, including an explicit empty body replacement. Return bounded structured JSON diagnostics and contract exit codes for --json errors.
Test real CLI stdin/file paths and service entry points with malformed requests and before/after filesystem assertions.
cards.red: Duplicate-key/unknown-field request must fail instead of committing; oversized/deep/nonfinite/malformed input must produce bounded diagnostics with no mutation.
cards.green: No public path bypasses bounded parsing or closed-envelope validation; valid multiline/Unicode requests remain usable and empty replacement is distinct from omission.
cards.test: Run reader, CLI and service negative/positive tests, including stdin and file input, JSON diagnostic shapes and exits.

cards.title: Bind installed schema pins and truthful receipt provenance
work: Resolve schemas/descriptors from verified installed assets and product pin, including parent schema version; fail closed on absent/corrupt/mismatched pins with no working-directory fallback.
Hash the actual authoritative schema/descriptor bytes and record operation/storage/version/serializer/source/lock/authority identities; never substitute parsed-object hashes for byte hashes.
Capture transaction time once at preparation and reuse on retry; record actual generated-field provenance and performed/not-evaluated validation scopes.
Validate receipts against their schema and recompute every identity in tests; keep describe/validate read-only. Synchronize changed packaged assets.
cards.red: Corrupt/missing/mismatched product pin must deny writes; receipt assertions must reject zero hashes, fixed timestamps and invented validation scopes.
cards.green: Every successful receipt identifies verified assets, input/output and live authority with recomputable hashes and captured preparation time, in source and installed-wheel modes.
cards.test: Run pinned-registry/service/receipt tests and a wheel-without-checkout probe; check asset synchronization.

cards.title: Restore public-operation idempotency and complete request identity
work: Bind request identity to every behavior-affecting field: operation/kind/owner/target, semantics or patch, expected hash, body or explicit replacement and canonicalization consent; retain raw and normalized hashes distinctly.
Under mutation coordination, recognize a committed identical request before treating its original expected hash as a new stale write; return its durable prior receipt without rewriting.
Reject reuse with changed request content; distinguish committed, prepared, published, unchanged and ambiguous outcomes using recovery, never replaying evidence execution or Gate acceptance.

Cover service and CLI retries, body-only differences, expected-hash differences, no-op requests and unrelated later target edits; returning a historical receipt must not claim the live file is unchanged.
cards.red: Exact update retry must return its original receipt; same request ID with changed body must conflict rather than succeed.
cards.green: Identical retries reuse one durable result and prepared metadata; changed requests conflict; recovery does not overwrite newer edits or rerun external work.
cards.test: Run service/CLI/recovery tests for create/update/no-op and request collisions, with receipt count and byte-preservation assertions.

cards.title: Complete durable persistence and shared Core mutation locking
work: Use one canonical product-level lock for all cooperating mutation/recovery/no-op paths. Validate source and target under that lock; preserve Core authorization and transition-journal compatibility.

Implement atomic durable journal/receipt publication and explicit prepared/published/committed/uncertain outcomes with platform-specific fsync guarantees. Corrupt records must stop ambiguous recovery instead of disappearing.

Stage, parse and validate candidates before publication; verify live output bytes/schema afterward. Receipt failure after publication must return recoverable uncertainty, never false success or unchanged.
Integrate evidence/state/advance/decide/scaffold/coverage persistence through the common primitives after their existing authority checks; never rerun execution or auto-accept a Gate on recovery.
Audit no-replace fallback, lock liveness/release and staging cleanup against the contract; never expose an empty placeholder as an atomic create or remove an active file solely by age.

This finding spans several callers: before implementation, split into dependency-ordered child cards if needed, retaining every acceptance requirement and keeping this parent open until all children pass.
cards.red: Cross-process Writer/Core mutations must contend on the same lock; injected journal truncation, post-publish corruption and receipt failure must not report success or lose recovery identity.
cards.green: All cooperating mutations share product coordination and durable recoverable publication; actual output is verified, corrupt/ambiguous state fails closed, old Core receipt replay still works.
cards.test: Run atomic IO, concurrency, transaction recovery and Core evidence/transition/decision regressions; subprocess hard-kill boundaries must be exercised, with full platform qualification in AW-28.

cards.title: Run a genuine paired external-model evaluation with independent oracle
work: Preserve and clearly label the existing eight-case report as deterministic harness evidence, not model performance; keep original evidence distinguishable from new runs.
Freeze actual model/provider identity, budgets, randomized paired arms, held-out corpus, attempts/sample/stopping rules and uncertainty/non-regression criteria before measurement.

Implement an independent artifact-meaning/provenance/Core-gate oracle shared by raw-authoring and writer arms. Negative weakened-writer controls must detect dropped semantics, defaults, duplicate acceptance and forged evidence.

Use an authorized available endpoint, fresh sessions and identical intent. Preserve immutable prompts, tool attempts, artifacts, receipts, tokens/time, failures and actual model identity for both arms.

Report paired mechanical retries, first-pass structural rates and independent semantic outcomes with uncertainty. Missing endpoint, missing runs or inconclusive required benefit leave acceptance open; no simulated replacement.
cards.red: The old fixed-payload harness must be unable to satisfy the paired-run contract; intentionally weakened writers must fail the independent oracle.
cards.green: Real paired external-model evidence is independently reproducible and honestly demonstrates or falsifies benefit; no performance claim rests on serializer unit tests. Any unmet source performance criterion remains open for AW-20.
cards.test: Validate harness negative controls, then execute the preregistered external protocol and verify immutable evidence hashes, actual model identities and paired statistics.

cards.title: Complete real platform crash and release qualification
work: Run real subprocess concurrent Writer/Core creates/updates and hard-kill recovery at prepare/publish/readback/receipt boundaries on Windows and actual POSIX filesystems.
Exercise Windows sharing/reparse/case/ADS and POSIX symlink/rename/link behavior on capable hosts; Git Bash alone is not POSIX filesystem evidence.
Run full pytest, both smoke/layout validators on fresh installs, asset drift, legacy path/command classification and installed-wheel-without-checkout describe/create/update/validate.

Record exact host/runtime/filesystem/source/contract/wheel identities, commands/exits and immutable log hashes. Keep missing mandatory platforms/privileges/checks open; do not replace them with mocks.
Separate real lifecycle execution from MockChangeBuilder fixture coverage and verify Core evidence/decision/archival behavior for supported routes.
cards.red: A missing required platform, hard-kill boundary, isolated-wheel check or successful unauthorized mutation must prevent acceptance.
cards.green: All mandatory deterministic, real Windows/POSIX and installed-wheel checks pass on the qualified implementation with auditable evidence; no mandatory skip is relabeled complete.
cards.test: Execute the complete VALIDATION.md release matrix and record per-platform commands, exit codes and evidence hashes. Fixes discovered here require explicit implementation cards and requalification.

review_snapshot.note: AW-00 through AW-19 retain historical implementation statuses; these are not current acceptance evidence. AW-21 through AW-28 supersede the disputed completion claims.
